description: This file contains a utility class OverScrollerCompat that provides backward-compatible access to the getCurrVelocity() method of android.widget.OverScroller, handling API level differences.

classes.name: OverScrollerCompat
classes.description: A utility class for using OverScroller in a backward-compatible way.

methods.name: getCurrVelocity
methods.description: Returns the current velocity from OverScroller if available (API >= ICE_CREAM_SANDWICH), otherwise returns 0.
